text: oh yeah so if u want to see some more of that zig-zag pattern that happens in places where i think its the same problem in another face is this check it out notice how this face on a brand new cylinder is doing some insane work. and how i know its doing some insane work is this is what a 'fill face' does when paintingn [Image #16] doesnt even fill the entire face oh shit i didnt put up the first ss here [Image #17]
resolution: The 'insane work' cap fan is normal n-gon triangulation (the cap IS one authored face; the fan from a rim vertex is just its render triangulation), but the fill-face truncation was real: model_paint.groupFaces collected group members into a fixed MAX_GROUP_FACES=16 stack buffer while a 48-side cylinder cap fans into 46 triangles — 'fill face' painted the first 16 slivers and silently stopped, the pink wedge in the screenshot. Raised the buffer to 128 and made any residual truncation LOUD on stderr ([mesh] line naming the group and the cap) per the truncation-is-loud rule. Committed 4bcb18737; needs host rebuild. Related loop-cut zigzag diagnosed and fixed separately under req_3037.
